resolution.question: Ravi and the private seller of a 2019 hatchback are 40,000 rupees apart. Will they agree on a price in the three days before the seller's posted listing expires?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that Ravi and the seller have agreed on a price (e.g., a binding message exchange indicating acceptance of an offer). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
